name: nextMotion
summary: Open-source single-page portfolio template with project cards and a Nodemailer contact form.
description: A developer portfolio template built with animated components (Aceternity UI, Framer Motion): intro, 'what I'm working on' project cards with tech tags, about content and a contact form whose messages are sent through Nodemailer using a Gmail app password. Deploys to Vercel serverless functions.
contains: single-page portfolio: intro, projects, about and contact
project cards with images and tech tags
contact form emails via Nodemailer with a Gmail app password
UI built with shadcn/ui, Aceternity UI and Framer Motion
deploy to Vercel (serverless functions for the email endpoint)
